blueprint.help_title: The ledger, and what opening a row means
blueprint.help_body: Layer one is the ledger and nothing else: nine columns, six of them thin and headed by an icon, are the drawing. Layer two is not somewhere else, it is the row you opened, grown. Each of its nine cells becomes the full drawing of its own reason, in the same order, ruled against the column it came from. Going back puts every panel into the cell it came out of, and lands you on the row you left.
